sections.title: Healing and raising
items: Misc fixes to raise/swiftcast logic, relevant rotation-specific settings have been adjusted a bit
White Mage: Thin Air no longer forces a hard-cast Raise. Raising follows your raise settings, and GCDs continue while moving.
Minor fix for Astrologian Synastry.
Gunbreaker Aurora on "Full target usage" goes to the member who needs healing, not the one with the smallest HP pool.
Paladins under Hallowed Ground no longer count as needing heals.
Dancer finishes Improvisation with Improvised Finish, so the party gets its barrier.

sections.title: Targeting
items: Line attacks such as Doom Spike, Chain Saw and Shadowbringer count the enemies toward the target, not along your facing.
The "Cleave" AoE type no longer blocks group heals and party mitigation.
"Only attack targets on screen" and the vision cone option no longer block heals and buffs on party members behind the camera.
"Prefer lower-HP targets with the Big targeting type" now takes effect.
The Shirk command no longer targets yourself.
"Provoke any enemy" now respects the Don't provoke list.

sections.title: Tanks
items: Paladin Intervention can target a co-tank, so its co-tank options work.
Paladin and Warrior use Reprisal on raidwides, like Dark Knight and Gunbreaker.
Rampart now counts when tanks stagger their big mitigations.
Gunbreaker uses Trajectory for Move Forward.

sections.title: Misc Rotations
items: Viper no longer spends Uncoiled Fury beside a ready Serpent's Ire, and Monk's odd-minute Perfect Balance is no longer blocked at full charges.
Samurai keeps Feint for AOE damage instead of using it on its own low health.
Tinctures are only used in combat or during a countdown, in every rotation.
The BossMod movement safety option now also checks Dragonfire Dive, Stardiver and Forked Raiju, and no longer holds back a gap closer when you already within melee range.
Misc fixes for physical-damage detection, the Sage Addersgall timer and the BossMod special modes.

sections.title: Settings
items: "Reset to Default Value." restores the default for switches instead of turning them off.
Chat commands can now set delay ranges and colours, e.g. /rotation Settings HealWhenNothingTodoDelay <0.5, 1>. Colours also accept hex, like #FF000066.
Number settings set by chat command accept a decimal point on every system language, so 0.5 no longer becomes 5 where a decimal comma is used.

sections.title: Interface
items: New "Animation length" setting under UI > Customize. Set it to 0% to turn animations off.
Delay ranges, such as "Delay between clicks", are now a single slider with two handles instead of separate Minimum and Maximum rows.
The interface accent colour setting now offers the same preset colours as the tutorial.
The tutorial's macro Copy buttons show a check once copied.

sections.title: Targeting
items: Actions with unique target behaviour now work correctly.
Fixed issue with "switch target to friendly" setting.

sections.title: Settings
items: Fixed a rare bug where an unrelated game crash could cause settings to be wiped.
Removed the "Presses per action" setting. Button presses on hotbars now always play two or three times per action.

sections.title: Healing
items: oGCD heals triggered by commands execute properly.

sections.title: Rotations
items: WHM, VPR, and DNC tincures are now only used in combat.

sections.title: Performance
items: Minor optimizations to performance in high object environments. Target checks are more efficient.
